content: {"episode_id":"ep-05074","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was ordered for a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). The monitoring study is required to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation. This service addresses a distinct diagnostic question documented in the clinical indication note and should not be treated as bundled and non-payable under CO-97. We request reconsideration and reimbursement of the outstanding balance of 358.20."}
